related.title: 分散式共識服務
related.why: 耐久日誌及提交證據相通
related.whyEn: Durable logs and commit evidence transfer
related.transfer: 耐久日誌及提交證據相通
related.transferEn: Durable logs and commit evidence transfer
related.difference: 本地 ACID 與跨節點共識具有不同失效模型
related.differenceEn: Local ACID and consensus have different failure models
practice: 由「ACID 分離」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「本地 ACID 與跨節點共識具有不同失效模型」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From acid separation, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "Local ACID and consensus have different failure models", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.

history.title: 交易與隔離
history.text: 官方公開資料「PostgreSQL 預寫日誌」提供架構脈絡；本課先由「ACID 分離」及「交易邊界」建立邊界，再進入實驗判讀。這是原創教材的學習順序，不是宣稱技術發明年代。
history.textEn: The primary reference PostgreSQL write-ahead logging supplies architectural context. These original lessons start with acid separation and transaction boundaries before experiments; this is a learning sequence, not an invention-date claim.
